name: PlayStation 5 Console (Disc Edition)
description: The PS5 Disc Edition delivers a new generation of gaming with lightning-fast load times, haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D Audio. This certified refurbished unit has been tested and verified by Sony.

name: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition
description: The PS5 Digital Edition is an all-digital console with no disc drive — download every game straight from PlayStation Store. This certified refurbished unit is fully tested and verified by Sony.

name: PlayStation 5 Slim (Disc Edition)
description: The new PS5 Slim is over 30% smaller and 18% lighter than the original PS5. Features a detachable Ultra HD Blu-ray disc drive and a 1TB SSD — the perfect next-gen console in a sleeker package.

name: PlayStation 5 Slim Digital Edition
description: The PS5 Slim Digital is the all-digital version of the slimmer PS5 redesign — no disc drive, 30% smaller, and with an 825GB SSD. Download your entire library from PlayStation Store.

name: PlayStation 4 Pro
description: The most powerful PlayStation 4 ever made. PS4 Pro is enhanced for PS4 Pro and can play all PS4 games. Level up to 4K gaming, streaming entertainment and more.

name: PlayStation 4 Slim
description: The most affordable entry point to thousands of incredible PlayStation games. The PS4 Slim is compact, quiet, and built for hours of entertainment.

name: PlayStation 5 Pro
description: The PlayStation 5 Pro is the most powerful PlayStation ever — featuring a Custom AMD GPU with 67% more Compute Units, PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, and a massive 2TB SSD for the ultimate gaming experience.

name: PS5 Console – God of War Ragnarök Bundle
description: Get the PlayStation 5 console bundled with God of War Ragnarök. Experience Kratos and Atreus's epic journey across the Nine Realms on the world's most powerful PlayStation.

name: PS5 Console – Spider-Man 2 Bundle
description: Swing into action with the PS5 Marvel's Spider-Man 2 bundle. Includes the PS5 console with a Marvel's Spider-Man 2 game voucher and a special-edition DualSense controller.

name: PS5 Console – EA Sports FC 25 Bundle
description: The ultimate gaming bundle for football fans. Includes the PS5 console, EA Sports FC 25 disc, and a DualSense wireless controller. Play the beautiful game at its most beautiful.

name: PS5 Console – Call of Duty Bundle
description: Go to war with the PS5 Call of Duty bundle. Get the full PS5 experience alongside a Call of Duty game disc and immersive DualSense haptic feedback that puts you in the action.

name: PS5 Slim – Spider-Man 2 Bundle
description: The compact PS5 Slim packaged with Marvel's Spider-Man 2. Enjoy the slimmer, lighter PS5 design without sacrificing any performance, alongside one of PS5's best exclusives.

name: PlayStation 4 Pro 1TB (Jet Black)
description: The PS4 Pro 1TB in Jet Black gives you the full 4K gaming experience at a budget-friendly price. Perfect for gamers who want premium performance without upgrading to PS5.

name: PS4 Pro 1TB + Extra DualShock 4 Bundle
description: The PS4 Pro 1TB console bundled with an extra DualShock 4 controller — perfect for multiplayer gaming. Get 4K gaming and share the experience with friends and family.

name: PlayStation 4 Slim 1TB
description: The PS4 Slim 1TB offers double the storage of the standard model for all your game installs and saves. Compact, quiet, and great value for your gaming setup.

name: PlayStation 4 Slim 500GB (Certified Refurbished)
description: Certified Refurbished PS4 Slim 500GB — inspected, tested, and cleaned by Sony-certified technicians. Backed by a 90-day warranty. The most affordable way to get into PlayStation gaming.

name: PS4 Slim – The Last of Us Bundle
description: Experience one of gaming's greatest stories on the PS4 Slim. Includes the console and The Last of Us Remastered game disc — ideal for fans of the acclaimed TV series.

name: PS4 Slim – GTA V Bundle
description: The PS4 Slim bundled with Grand Theft Auto V — one of the best-selling games of all time. Explore Los Santos and GTA Online with friends. Great value for new PS4 owners.

name: PS4 Slim – EA Sports FC 24 Bundle
description: The perfect bundle for football fans. The PS4 Slim console comes with EA Sports FC 24 — the world's most popular football game. Great for the whole family.

name: PS5 Console (Disc Edition) + Extra DualSense Bundle
description: Get the PS5 Disc Edition paired with an extra DualSense Wireless Controller — perfect for multiplayer gaming right out of the box. Includes 1TB SSD and Ultra HD Blu-ray drive.

name: DualSense Wireless Controller
description: Discover a deeper, highly immersive gaming experience that brings the action to life in the palms of your hands. Feel physically responsive feedback and tension in the triggers.

name: DualSense Edge Wireless Controller
description: The ultra-customizable DualSense Edge controller lets you fine-tune your setup with swappable stick caps, back buttons, adjustable trigger stops, and custom button remapping profiles.

name: DualSense Controller – Midnight Black
description: The DualSense wireless controller in bold Midnight Black. The same industry-leading haptic feedback and adaptive triggers in a sleek, dark colorway that stands out.

name: DualSense Controller – Cosmic Red
description: Make your mark with the DualSense wireless controller in Cosmic Red. A striking two-tone design combines a deep red casing with black details for a bold look.

name: DualSense Controller – Starlight Blue
description: The DualSense wireless controller in Starlight Blue. A celestial two-tone design with a translucent dark blue casing and light accents inspired by the night sky.

name: DualSense Controller – Nova Pink
description: Express your style with the DualSense wireless controller in Nova Pink. A vibrant two-tone design with a light pink casing and white accents that pops on any desk.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Jet Black
description: The iconic DualShock 4 wireless controller for PlayStation 4. Features a built-in touchpad, SHARE button, light bar, and stereo headphone jack for complete gaming control.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Midnight Blue
description: The DualShock 4 wireless controller in Midnight Blue. Same full-featured DualShock 4 experience with a sleek deep blue finish that looks great in any setup.

name: DualSense Controller – Volcanic Red
description: Stand out with the DualSense Volcanic Red. A fiery two-tone red and black design that makes a statement. Same award-winning haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.

name: DualSense Controller – Sterling Silver
description: A premium metallic look for your gaming setup. The DualSense Sterling Silver features a brushed silver casing with dark accents — sophisticated and sleek.

name: DualSense Controller – Cobalt Blue
description: The DualSense in Cobalt Blue brings a vibrant, electric blue look to your controller collection. Eye-catching design with all the haptic and trigger technology you love.

name: DualSense Controller – Galactic Purple
description: The DualSense Galactic Purple features a rich purple casing with white accents, giving your setup an out-of-this-world look without compromising on performance.

name: DualSense Controller – Chroma Teal
description: A fresh take on DualSense colours. The Chroma Teal features a cool teal and black two-tone finish that looks stunning under any lighting. Limited availability.

name: DualSense Edge – Midnight Black
description: The pro DualSense Edge in Midnight Black. All the customisability of the Edge — swappable sticks, back buttons, trigger stops — in a stealthy all-black colourway.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Wave Blue
description: The DualShock 4 in Wave Blue features a transparent blue shell that shows off the internals. A fan-favourite colourway that never goes out of style.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Magma Red
description: The DualShock 4 in bold Magma Red. A striking solid red finish that makes this controller stand out on any shelf. Full DualShock 4 features included.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Crystal (Limited Edition)
description: The limited edition DualShock 4 Crystal features a fully transparent shell revealing the components inside. A collector's must-have and a conversation starter.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Green Camouflage
description: The DualShock 4 in Green Camouflage print. A rugged, military-inspired design that's popular with Call of Duty and shooter fans. Full DualShock 4 feature set.

name: DualShock 4 Controller – Copper
description: The rich, warm copper finish of this DualShock 4 is a premium twist on the classic controller. Looks stunning alongside gold or dark gaming setups.

name: PS4 DualShock 4 Back Button Attachment
description: Add two remappable back buttons to your DualShock 4 controller. The official PlayStation attachment clips on easily and features an OLED display for profile status. No soldering required.

name: Pulse 3D Wireless Headset
description: Refined for the PlayStation 5 era, the PULSE 3D wireless headset offers seamless compatibility with PS5's Tempest 3D AudioTech for an enveloping audio experience.

name: Pulse Elite Wireless Headset
description: The Pulse Elite wireless headset delivers premium sound with planar magnetic drivers and a lossless PlayStation Link audio connection to PS5, PC, and Mac. AI-powered noise rejection keeps your voice crystal clear.

name: Pulse Explore Wireless Earbuds
description: Pulse Explore wireless earbuds bring the PlayStation Link lossless audio experience to an ultra-portable form factor. AI noise rejection and comfortable fit for marathon gaming sessions.

name: DualSense Charging Station
description: Charge up to two DualSense wireless controllers simultaneously with the official PlayStation charging station. Just drop your controllers in and they start charging automatically — no cable required.

name: PlayStation VR2
description: PlayStation VR2 is Sony's next-generation VR headset for PS5. With OLED 4K HDR displays, eye tracking, foveated rendering, and the Sense controllers with haptic feedback, it's the most immersive gaming experience ever created.

name: HD Camera
description: The PlayStation HD Camera features dual 1080p lenses and a built-in stand for seamless integration with PS5. Background removal technology lets you appear in your gameplay and streams without a green screen.

name: PS5 Media Remote
description: Control your PS5's media playback, streaming apps, and Blu-ray movies effortlessly with the PlayStation 5 Media Remote. Infrared TV controls built in so you can manage your whole entertainment setup.

name: Seagate 1TB Expansion SSD for PS5
description: Officially licensed by PlayStation, this 1TB M.2 SSD expansion card fits directly into the PS5's expansion slot, giving you more room for your growing game library — no external cables needed.

name: Seagate 2TB Expansion SSD for PS5
description: Double the storage of your PS5 with this 2TB M.2 NVMe expansion SSD. Store even more AAA titles, DLCs, and game updates without worrying about space. Officially licensed by PlayStation.

name: Seagate 2TB Game Drive for PS4
description: Expand your PS4 storage with this plug-and-play 2TB external game drive. Store up to 50 PS4 games and access them directly from the PlayStation menu. No additional power cable needed.

name: Pulse 3D Wireless Headset – Midnight Black
description: The PULSE 3D wireless headset in Midnight Black delivers the same immersive 3D Audio experience fine-tuned for PS5, in a bold all-black colourway that suits any dark gaming setup.

name: Pulse 3D Wireless Headset – Grey Camouflage
description: The PULSE 3D in Grey Camouflage is a fan-favourite limited colourway. The same award-winning 3D Audio headset optimised for PS5, with a unique grey camo print.

name: PlayStation VR2 Sense Controller Charging Station
description: Keep your PS VR2 Sense controllers ready for action. This official charging station charges both controllers simultaneously and features LED indicators to show charge status.

name: PS5 Console Covers – Midnight Black
description: Give your PS5 a bold new look with the official Midnight Black console covers. Snap-on covers fit perfectly and require no tools. Compatible with both disc and digital editions.

name: PS5 Console Covers – Cosmic Red
description: Transform your PS5 with the official Cosmic Red console covers. Match your Cosmic Red DualSense controller for a fully coordinated red-and-black gaming setup.

name: Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 Cable (2m)
description: Unlock your PS5's full potential with this Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 cable. Supports 4K at 120fps, 8K at 60fps, and Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) for the smoothest gaming experience possible.

name: PlayStation Plus 12-Month Membership
description: Get 12 months of PlayStation Plus Essential — including monthly free games, online multiplayer access, exclusive discounts, and 100GB of cloud storage for game saves.

name: PS5 Disc Edition Vertical Stand
description: Keep your PS5 Disc Edition safely upright with this official vertical stand. Provides stable support and proper ventilation clearance. A must-have for any PS5 disc console owner.

name: PS5 Figure-8 Power Cable (1.8m)
description: A replacement or spare figure-8 (IEC C7) power cable for your PS5 or PS4. 1.8 metres long for flexible placement. Rated for 250V / 10A — fully compatible with South African power outlets.

name: EA Sports FC 25
description: The world's #1 football game is back. EA Sports FC 25 brings unmatched realism with FC IQ, a brand new tactical system, updated clubs and leagues, and deeper Ultimate Team and Career Mode experiences. The most popular game in South Africa.

name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
description: The next chapter of Black Ops is here. Set in the early 1990s, Black Ops 6 features a twisting spy thriller campaign, fan-favourite multiplayer modes, and the return of round-based Zombies. Cross-play with PC and Xbox included.

name: Grand Theft Auto V (PS5 Enhanced Edition)
description: The critically acclaimed open-world crime epic, rebuilt for PS5. Featuring up to 4K resolution, 60fps performance mode, faster loading, and access to GTA Online — the ever-evolving multiplayer world with millions of players worldwide.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
description: Swing through Marvel's New York as Peter Parker and Miles Morales in this PS5 exclusive. Face Venom and the Symbiote threat in an emotionally charged adventure that pushes PS5 hardware to its limits.

name: Mortal Kombat 1
description: A new era of the iconic fighting franchise begins. MK1 reimagines the Mortal Kombat universe from the ground up with an all-new story, stunning visuals, Kameo Fighter system, and brutal fatalities fans love.

name: WWE 2K24
description: Step inside the squared circle with WWE 2K24. Featuring over 200 playable superstars, revamped MyFaction and MyRise modes, and the most authentic WWE simulation experience to date.

name: NBA 2K25
description: The ultimate basketball experience is back. NBA 2K25 features the most realistic on-court gameplay yet, updated rosters, immersive MyCareer, and the biggest MyTeam ever. For every NBA fan in South Africa.

name: God of War Ragnarök
description: The Norse saga continues. Join Kratos and Atreus on an epic journey across all Nine Realms as they face gods, monsters, and the coming of Ragnarök. Winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards.

name: Minecraft
description: The world's best-selling game. Build, explore, and survive in an infinite world of blocks. Minecraft is perfect for all ages and includes the Bedrock Edition with cross-play across PS4, PS5, PC, and mobile.

name: Tekken 8
description: The king of iron fist tournament returns. Tekken 8 delivers the most visually stunning and mechanically deep fighting game in the series with 32 characters, a gripping story mode, and new Heat System gameplay mechanics.

name: EA Sports UFC 5
description: Step into the Octagon with EA Sports UFC 5. Real-time damage, clinch-to-strike transitions, and the most authentic mixed martial arts simulation ever made. Over 300 fighters including South African MMA stars.

name: Need for Speed Unbound
description: Race through Lakeshore City in the most stylish NFS ever. Unbound features stunning art direction blending photorealistic cars with bold graffiti animations. Build your rep from street racer to ultimate champion.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Experience the wizarding world like never before. Set in the 1800s Hogwarts, this open-world RPG lets you attend classes, learn spells, brew potions, and uncover a dangerous secret that threatens the wizarding world.

name: The Last of Us Part I
description: Experience the award-winning post-apocalyptic story of Joel and Ellie, fully rebuilt for PS5. As seen in the acclaimed HBO TV series — now play the game that started it all in stunning 4K at 60fps.

name: Elden Ring
description: Rise, Tarnished, and become Elden Lord. From the creators of Dark Souls, Elden Ring is a massive open-world action RPG co-created with George R.R. Martin. Game of the Year winner and one of the best games ever made.
specs: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC Available

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Live the outlaw life in Night City. Cyberpunk 2077 is a massive open-world RPG where you play as V — a mercenary outlaw going after a one-of-a-kind implant. The PS5 version runs at 4K/60fps with ray tracing.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: An epic tale of life in America at the dawn of the modern age. RDR2 follows outlaw Arthur Morgan in one of gaming's greatest stories. Includes Red Dead Online for multiplayer adventures on the frontier.

name: Assassin's Creed Mirage
description: Return to the roots of Assassin's Creed. Set in 9th-century Baghdad, Mirage follows Basim as he rises from street thief to master assassin. Classic parkour, stealth, and a focused 20-hour adventure.

name: Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time
description: The original marsupial is back and this time it's on a grand multiverse adventure. Crash Bandicoot 4 features over 100 levels, 4 playable characters, and more bonus content than any previous entry in the series.

name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege Deluxe Edition
description: The definitive tactical shooter. Rainbow Six Siege rewards teamwork, strategy, and precise communication. The Deluxe Edition includes Year 1 operators for an expanded roster from day one. Cross-play available.
